name: Eğitim
description: Okul, ders, sınav; zaman ve sayı ifadeleri.

cards.enS: I attend class every day.
She takes an exam tomorrow.

cards.enS: He gets a scholarship for his grades.

He never cheats on a test.
I revise for finals every June.

cards.enS: She hands in her essay early.
cards.trS: O deneme yazısını erken teslim eder.

cards.enS: We attend a lecture on Tuesdays.
I take a break between classes.

She takes a gap year after school.

He crams for the test at the last minute.
We form a study group of four.
cards.trS: Dört kişilik bir çalışma grubu kurarız.

cards.enS: She presents her project confidently.
You earn credits each semester.
The teacher hands back the tests.
I get feedback from my teacher.
I crammed for the exam all night.
cards.trS: Bütün gece sınava son anda çalıştım.

It is hard to keep up with the class.
I got the hang of it after a week.
cards.trS: Bir hafta sonra püf noktasını kaptım.

I can tell the time in English.
He is always on time.

I set a reminder for the call.

I calculate the total quickly.
She doubles the number easily.

He measures the distance carefully.
I estimate the cost roughly.
She rounds the number up.

She reschedules her appointment.

cards.enS: Children count down to New Year.
cards.trS: Çocuklar yeni yıla geri sayım yapar.

cards.enS: I add up the numbers quickly.
She subtracts the discount.
He multiplies the amount by two.
She is very punctual.

The kids take turns on the swing.
Sorry, I'm running late.
He arrived just in time.

We work against the clock today.
She marks the date on the calendar.

He catches up on work at night.

I look at the calendar every morning.
I am pressed for time this week.
She juggles work and study all year.
cards.trS: O bütün yıl işle okulu bir arada yürütüyor.

cards.enS: Could you hand out the worksheets, please?
Take one and pass them on.
cards.trS: Bir tane al ve arkaya ver.

cards.enS: Work in pairs and compare your answers.
Get into groups of four, please.
Find a partner and practise the dialogue.
cards.trS: Bir eş bul ve diyaloğu çalış.

cards.enS: Put your hands up if you have finished.
Work on your own for five minutes.
Copy this down in your notebooks.
Everyone look at the board, please.
Listen and repeat after me.
cards.trS: Dinleyin ve benden sonra tekrar edin.

cards.enS: Would you read the passage aloud for us?
cards.trS: Parçayı bizim için sesli okur musun?

cards.enS: Underline the key words in the question.
Swap papers with your partner and check.
cards.trS: Kâğıtları eşinizle değiştirin ve kontrol edin.

cards.enS: Quiet down, everybody, we are starting.
She clapped twice to get everyone’s attention.
cards.trS: Herkesin dikkatini toplamak için iki kez el çırptı.

cards.enS: Please keep the noise down during the test.
Stay in your seat until the bell rings.
Put your phone away, please.
Line up at the door quietly.
Wait your turn and do not shout out.
There are not enough books, so share the materials.
Tidy up the classroom before you leave.
The teacher dismissed the class five minutes early.
cards.trS: Öğretmen dersi beş dakika erken bitirdi.

cards.en: keep an eye on the class
cards.enS: Could you keep an eye on the class for a minute?
cards.trS: Bir dakika sınıfa göz kulak olabilir misin?

cards.enS: We set ground rules in the first lesson.
It takes an hour to mark thirty essays.
cards.trS: Otuz ödevi okumak bir saat sürüyor.

cards.enS: Try to give constructive feedback, not just a mark.
cards.trS: Sadece not değil, yapıcı geri bildirim vermeye çalış.

cards.enS: She pointed out a common mistake on the board.
cards.trS: Tahtada sık yapılan bir hatayı gösterdi.

cards.enS: Praise the effort, not only the result.
The teacher set a short writing task.
cards.trS: Öğretmen kısa bir yazma görevi verdi.

cards.enS: She sets homework every Friday.
cards.tr: ödev vermek (öğretmen tarafı; öğrenci "do homework" der)

cards.enS: Let us go over the answers together.
Each correct answer is awarded a point.
cards.trS: Her doğru cevaba bir puan veriliyor.

cards.enS: Marks are deducted for late work.
cards.trS: Geç teslim edilen ödevden puan kırılıyor.

cards.enS: Most of the class met the learning objective.
We assess progress twice a term.
Teachers write report cards at the end of term.
The whole year group sits the exam in June.
cards.trS: Bütün sınıf düzeyi haziranda sınava giriyor.

cards.enS: The school holds a parents’ evening in November.

cards.en: raise a concern with a parent
cards.enS: He raised a concern with the parents about attendance.
The form reports each student’s progress.
I covered a colleague’s lesson this morning.
cards.trS: Bu sabah bir meslektaşımın dersine girdim.

cards.enS: She prepares a lesson plan for every class.
cards.trS: Her ders için ders planı hazırlıyor.

cards.enS: We have to follow the syllabus closely.
Good teachers adapt the material to the class.
Differentiate the task so everyone can take part.
The teacher keeps a register of absences.
Two teachers supervise the playground at break.
cards.trS: Teneffüste iki öğretmen bahçe nöbeti tutuyor.

cards.enS: All teachers attend a staff meeting on Mondays.
She took on a new class in September.
